brief: 第一人称射击竞技手游(FPS)UI 套件:大厅、军械库、战斗 HUD、结算、通行证/商店、设置,统一硬核科幻军事风。

pages.role: Lobby — player brand & rank, big start matchmaking entry, mode select, secondary entries (armory/shop/battlepass).
Armory/customize — weapon list, selected-weapon display slot, attachment slots + stat bars, skins.
In-game HUD — hp/armor, ammo & reload, minimap, kill feed, crosshair, mobile FPS move/fire control zones.
Result — win/lose, personal KDA & score, team comparison, xp & currency earned, play again.
Battlepass/shop — pass progress & tier rewards, shop weapons & skins, currency & bundles.
Settings — sensitivity slider, music/sfx/voice, quality & framerate, key-layout entry, language, restore defaults.

styleAxes.mood: 硬核科幻军事:暗夜战术作战屏,冷峻、克制、信息密度高。
styleAxes.accent: 战术青橙双色:主青 #2DE2C8(科技读数)+ 警示橙 #FF7A2D(行动/危险),底色近黑 #0A0F14。
styleAxes.density: 高密度信息板:窄边框、细分割线、紧凑数据行,等宽数字读数。
styleAxes.shape: 锐利切角矩形为主、小圆角 6-10px,HUD 元件半透明叠层,统一 1-2px 描边。
